title: 5.4 Solving Special Systems of Linear Equations

icans: I can tell how many solutions a system has.
I can solve systems with no solution or infinitely many solutions.
I can use special systems to solve real-life problems.

vocab: ___________ lines (same slope, different y-intercepts); solving gives a false statement such as 0 = 5
the same line (same slope and ______________); solving gives a true statement such as 0 = 0

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Parallel lines: Same slope, different y-intercepts: _______________ solution (a _______________ statement).
Same line: Same slope and y-intercept: _______________ solutions (a _______________ statement).
